prompt_inputs.goal: Complete a 20km marathon training run with high intensity intervals

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains 3-4 meals totaling 3000-3500 calories appropriate for a 72kg endurance athlete
Includes carbohydrate-rich meals timed before and after the training run to optimize performance and recovery
All meals respect vegetarian and nut-free dietary restrictions
Plan is presented in a compact, single-day format with clear meal timing
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-intensity endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring elevated calorie and carbohydrate intake with specific timing around training windows

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle and increase strength through weightlifting

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers one full day with at least 4 meals/snacks
Includes pre- and post-workout nutrition timed around gym session
All foods are vegetarian with no meat, poultry, or fish
Provides balanced macronutrients supporting muscle building (approximately 1.6-2.2g protein per kg bodyweight)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) with dietary restrictions (vegetarian) requiring balanced macronutrients and meal timing around gym sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Post-injury recovery with anti-inflammatory nutrition while maintaining swimming performance

solution_criteria: Includes 4-5 meals/snacks with anti-inflammatory foods (e.g., fatty fish, berries, leafy greens, turmeric)
Meal plan is compact and fits on one page or concise format
Portions are appropriate for 72kg athlete with modified intensity due to injury recovery
Maintains adequate protein intake for muscle recovery and athletic performance
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific athlete (swimmer) recovering from injury, needing anti-inflammatory foods and modified portions while maintaining performance nutrition
